info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Documents Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve documents related to specific insurance claims. This API supports the efficient searching and listing of claim documents based on unique identifiers. It is particularly useful for insurance adjusters, claims managers, and other stakeholders who need to review claim-related documentation. By facilitating quick access to critical information, this API enhances operational efficiency and supports informed decision-making in the claims process.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve documents related to specific claims. You can access various types of documents that are associated with the claims in the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving documents related to claims. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema.
